main_text.l: Hic fortasse quispiam haesitabit, quaeretque quum
unus hic Bernardus non unus sit, sed tam dispar sibi, &
plane diversus, cui potius fides habenda? dicam, po-
tius Bernardo Textum defixis, quam obliquis oculis in-
tuenti: nam in Epistol. ad Conradum Bernardus Textum
obiter tantum aspiciens, praetermisso sensu, ad verba
tantum allusit: At in illa, ad Archiepiscopum Senonensem,
in versando tractandoque Textu sedulo immoratur:
Addo, non Bernardo tantum dicenti, sed facienti quo-
que, & sententiam suam {*}factis comprobanti. Ut ta-
ceam, ex priore expositione Bernardum exigere a Princi-
pibus Reverentiam erga Episcopos, quam nos quoque
deberi confitemur: at ex posteriori sensu ab Episcopis
erga Principes obedientiam & subiectionem efflagitat.
Haec de uno Bernardo, nunc de multis illis Patribus.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Pontificiu[?]" (line 1 of the second paragraph) is unclear; the ending may be -ium or -iae. The bottom-left signature "G2" is faint and uncertain. The reference "Digref.[?]" in the right margin is probably "Digest." but the print is unclear. The margin note letter "c" is read from the mark in the text, and the printed mark in the note may be "e". "Sine" in "etiamsi sine Apostolus" may be "siue"; I read it as "siue" from the repeated pattern. "Oecumenius" and "Camarinam" are read as printed but are faint. The two-line "Pe-rerio" at the foot is taken as one word split across the last line.
